nodes.g: Meres = "lofty" one of the 7 counsellors of Ahasuerus
Shethar = "a star" one of the 7 princes of Media or Persian empire
Ahasuerus = "I will be silent and poor" title of the king of Persia, probably Xerxes
Memucan = "dignified" one of the 7 princes of Persia in the reign of Ahasuerus
Carshena = "illustrious" one of the 7 princes of Persia and Media under king Ahasuerus
Marsena = "worthy" one of the 7 counsellors of Ahasuerus
